hypotheses.statement: People start paying by tapping the main button on the pay screen.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Most participants' first tap is on the main button.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Fewer than half of the participants' first tap is on the main button.

instrument.intro: TEST DATA. You will see a screen. Tap where you would start.
instrument.consent: TEST DATA. Your choices are kept without your name.

questions.text: TEST DATA. The customer has handed you the cash. Where do you tap to finish the payment?
